resources.string: Finds a door that works from here
Tap the button. It reads the public pools, sweeps Cloudflare\'s address space from this phone, and only keeps configs that actually carried a reply.
The config lists are blocked or offline right now, and there is no saved copy on this phone yet. Try once on another network — after one successful run it works from the saved copy.
No address answered at all, which usually means the whole range is blocked here rather than a single address being bad.
Addresses answered, but no config carried real traffic through them. The connections open and then die, which is what interference looks like rather than a dead server.
Your own name on the configs
Whatever channel name the pool stamped on a config is removed either way. This only decides what goes on instead.
